data.description:
Tread the Path of Champions - unforgettable for locals, international visitors and sports fans of all ages

This 90-minute BEHIND THE SCENES guided walking tour offers a dynamic, journey through the Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) precinct and the SCG Museum.
data.name: Behind The Scenes: Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) Guided Walking Tour

reviews.content: Really interesting and a few surprises on the tour. Our guide Karen was funny, informed and delivered her information very well. We would thoroughly recommend the tour if you love cricket.

As big sports fans this was a must see while in Sydney. Plenty of time to look around, ask questions and soak in the surroundings. Our guide Stuart was fantastic, really knowledgeable and provided lots of fun facts too. Interacted with everyone in our group, a natural host he made it even more enjoyable.

The link provided by Booking.com for location is not right , no where its mentioned that the venue to be reach is Gate A of Sydney cricket ground , because of it had to go around numerous times in heavy rain. Could you please update you geolocation for SCG tour entry mentioning to reach Gate A.
